abilities.name: Rifleman
abilities.text: When you declare an attack, replace 1 red die in your attack pool with 1 blue die.

abilities.name: Priority Target
abilities.text: Figures do not block line of sight for your attacks.

notes: Unique (dot before name). Subtitle: Clawdite Shapeshifter. Bottom boxed rows: '+2 Accuracy' keyword plus two surge lines.

name: Senator

abilities.name: Conspire
abilities.text: ⟶ Conspire: Roll your attack pool plus 1 yellow die. For each ⚡ result, to a maximum of 3, you or an adjacent friendly figure gains 1 [power token].

notes: Unique (dot before name). Subtitle: Clawdite Shapeshifter. The token icon in Conspire and in the 'Gain 1' surge line is a question mark inside a disc (a wildcard power token, not one of the four named token types); transcribed as [power token]. Bottom boxed rows: '+1 Accuracy' keyword plus three surge lines.

name: Streetrat

surgeAbilities.text: Assassin's Blade: After this attack resolves, choose an adjacent hostile figure and roll 1 red die. That figure suffers ⊠ equal to the ⊠ results.

abilities.name: Fleet
abilities.text: At the start of your activation, gain 2 movement points.

notes: Unique (dot before name). Subtitle: Clawdite Shapeshifter. Bottom boxed row holds the two short surge lines (⚡: +1⊠ and ⚡: Gain 1 [damage token]).
